dedupe_resolutions.notes: The announced U.S. inquiry into the reported Sirik wedding strike belongs to the existing Iran/Hormuz war record; it is a casualty-accountability development, not a separate strike count or finding of responsibility.
DOJ's Supreme Court stay application is the next appellate stage of the existing USPS mail-ballot rule dispute and does not create a parallel policy or ruling record.
The announced excavation timetable advances the already-recorded Triumphal Arch project; no separate construction event is counted before site work occurs.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

The records share a same-day White House fact sheet because it reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One is a set of announced company agreements; the other is an administration-reported program measurement.
